name: CreateTicket
title: Blocks/Create/CreateTicket
summary: The page a support agent creates a ticket on, on behalf of a customer: the creation header with Back, the brand, Tickets › Create Ticket and the account, then a centred form column with a small `PageHeader` and three `SettingsGroup` bands of `SettingsRow`s in flush `Card`s. Requester: a `Combobox` that searches contacts by name or email, each row an `Avatar` with the name and email, with Add new contact swapping it for Contact name and Contact email inputs, and CC as `MultiSelect` chips of email addresses. Request: Subject (`Input`), Description (`MarkdownEditor` with @mentions of agents and an attachments footer: Attach files and a `FileTokenGroup`), Channel, Type and Priority (`Select`, each priority a `PriorityTag`). Assignment: Group and Assignee (`Combobox`, the agents with `Avatar` presence and only those in the chosen group) and Tags (`MultiSelect` chips). Every field starts empty; Requester, Subject and Description carry the required mark. A raised `SaveBar` holds Cancel, Save and add another and Save (⌘ Enter). Fields turn invalid only after a create press, with a `FieldError` under each and focus on the first; there is no summary. A failed request opens a danger `Alert` with Retry under the page title, scrolled into view, and keeps every value; a created ticket raises a success `toast` with Open ticket and clears the form for the next one. Escape cancels, and a changed form asks before it is discarded (`ConfirmDialog`). The block fetches nothing: it emits `create` with the typed ticket and whether to add another, and the page passes back `submitting`, `error` or `created`.
intents: log a ticket for a customer
ticket form with requester and assignee
abrir chamado em nome de alguém

variants.name: ValidationErrors
variants.summary: Save pressed with gaps: Requester and Description are empty and a CC entry is not an email address, so each turns invalid with its message under it and focus moves to Requester; the typed Subject stays.

variants.name: ContactError
variants.summary: Add new contact chosen and Save pressed: Contact email holds an address with no domain ending and turns invalid, Subject and Description are empty and invalid too, and Search contacts goes back to the contact search.

variants.name: Submitting
variants.summary: A filled ticket in flight: Save spins, every field, Cancel and Save and add another are disabled until the answer comes back.

variants.name: SubmitError
variants.summary: The request failed: a danger Alert under the page title says the ticket wasn't created, with Retry, and every value stays as entered.

variants.name: Success
variants.summary: After Save and add another: a success toast names Ticket #4840 with Open ticket, and the form is empty again with focus on Requester.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The contacts, groups and agents are still arriving: skeleton rows hold the three bands and both create buttons are disabled.
